title: Strategic Insights: Evaluating Large Language Models' Decision-Making in Multi-Player Game-Theoretic Environments

contributions.purpose: 大规模多人(N=10)博弈场景下评测 LLM 策略决策
contributions.mechanism: 12 个匿名 LLM 在 6 种博弈(猜 2/3 均值/分钱/公共品/食客困境/大逃杀/海盗分金)中各 20 轮、5 次运行,共 360 个实例
contributions.evaluation: 整体 SRS 约 0.6-0.8(中等理性,偏离均衡 20-40%;人类脚注标注该数字模糊疑似幻觉)
contributions.domain: LLM 博弈论决策 / 多智能体行为评测
contributions.source_quote: Large-Scale Multi-Player Evaluation: Simulating 360 instances with N=10 agents across diverse game categories, extending beyond prior two-player foci

contributions.purpose: 提出跨博弈可比的策略理性量化指标 SRS
contributions.mechanism: 对 Nash 均衡偏离做归一化后加权聚合(合作 0.4 + 背叛 0.4 + 顺序 0.2)
contributions.evaluation: 正文报合作 0.78 > 背叛 0.65 > 顺序 0.52;人类脚注更正为合作 0.90、背叛 0.48、顺序 0.51;回归预测 MSE 正文 0.051、更正 0.20
contributions.source_quote: Novel Strategic Rationality Score (SRS): A weighted, normalized metric for aggregating equilibrium deviations, facilitating comparable rationality assessments and predictive modeling.

contributions.purpose: 揭示理性与模型规模脱钩、无轮次适应的反直觉规律
contributions.mechanism: t 检验(大/小模型)、混合效应模型(轮次演化)、Spearman 相关(特征-SRS)、ANOVA
contributions.source_quote: Trait-Linked Insights: Correlating performance with LLM features (e.g., parameter size, Theory of Mind inferences), revealing counterintuitive patterns like size-independent inconsistencies.

contributions.purpose: 提供可复现分析与开放数据
contributions.mechanism: 360 个实例 JSON + reproducing_results.ipynb,可在免费 Colab CPU 上 30 分钟内跑完
contributions.evaluation: 数据与代码以 Supplementary Material 及匿名仓库公开
contributions.source_quote: Empirical Rigor: Reproducible analyses testing adaptation, biases, and equilibria adherence, with open data for future extensions.

self_declared_provenance.quote: Our innovations—SRS, multi-player scaling, trait correlations—build on these, addressing calls for quantitative, reproducible benchmarks
Large-Scale Multi-Player Evaluation: Simulating 360 instances with N=10 agents across diverse game categories, extending beyond prior two-player foci
Contributions—SRS innovation, scaled simulations, trait analyses—provide benchmarks for alignment, advancing from dyadic probes [2] to robust multi-agent insights.

notes: 负结果为主体:H1(规模→理性)与 H3(轮次适应/学习)均被拒绝,H2 仅描述性部分支持且无正式检验(更正后背叛类 SRS 0.48 远低于正文声称的 0.65),ANOVA F=1.23 p=0.28(更正 F=0.14, p=1.00)显示 LLM 间无整体差异。关键出处问题:声称的 '360 instances simulations' 实为对 Huang et al. [36](GAMA-Bench)公开数据的再分析,博弈/智能体选择与实验运行均由 [36] 作者完成(附录及 checklist 明示),'Large-Scale Multi-Player Evaluation' 表述有夸大。16 条人类脚注纠错:引用 [24] 被认定为与本研究无关的 AI 幻觉引用;Table 1 数值疑似幻觉;多处统计量被更正(t/β/p/F/MSE);正文称最优模型 <X9x73kd>(llama-3.1-405b)实为 <my9FQ38>(gemini-1.5-pro)。第 4 节 Setup 出现 'Mixed 0.74 vs. <Rc3kmmq> 0.64',<Rc3kmmq> 是姊妹篇 AS0060(ToM-MADP)的匿名模型 ID,本篇 12 模型表中不存在,疑似跨论文内容污染。Checklist:假设生成与数据分析 D 级(全 AI),实验设计 C(依赖第三方公开数据、人类执行代码),写作 C(AI 写 Markdown、人类排 LaTeX);Observed AI Limitations 自承数值误报/编造、幻觉参考文献、代码含 bug。decision=withdrawn。
